en: <CLT=cltMIND>So this is my room...
<CLT=cltMIND>Well, it's not too shabby...
A key? Is it the key to this room?

Bingo! You got it right! Nice work!
That is, in fact, the key to this room!

You probably don't have anything worth
stealin' in here...

But you should still lock your door when
you leave!

Alright! Now it's time for me to give ya
a special hint!

If ya steal someone else's key, you can
sneak into their room and kill 'em easily!
Shut up! I don't wanna hear that!
Waaaaahhh! I-I just got chewed out!

<CLT=cltMIND>Geez, this place is the worst.
I just wanna go home.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should sleep to prepare for tomorrow.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should sleep to prepare for tomorrow.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should sleep to prepare for tomorrow.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
*sigh* I'm tired...

<CLT=cltMIND>As soon as my body hit the bed, my body
immediately froze.
<CLT=cltMIND>After everything that had happened...

<CLT=cltMIND>I forgot just how physically and mentally
exhausted I was...

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought we would achieve our goal as
long as we didn't give up.

<CLT=cltMIND>That had always been my mentality whenever
I practiced the piano...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...maybe playing piano is easier...
<CLT=cltMIND>...because I'm blessed...with that talent.

<CLT=cltMIND>With Chopin's "Prelude" playing in my head,
I fell into a deep sleep.

New students of the Ultimate Academy!
Congratulations!

The weeds here have grown thick with joy, as
if celebrating your entrance into this school.

Seeing your anxious eyes shine with murderous
intent makes me oh-so happy.

If you ever feel lost, don't be shy—talk to your
friends or a teacher. Let's all get along.
And...let's do lots of killing, too.

I pray for the physical and mental well-being
of this new killing school semester—

I mean...I pray for the well-being of you
students. Yes, that will do...
Is this a closet?
<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll take a look inside, just to be safe.
Huh? What is this?

<CLT=cltMIND>Inside, there were uniforms that matched the
one I was wearing. Lots of uniforms...
<CLT=cltMIND>Did they...prepare all these?

<CLT=cltMIND>They prepared everything just to keep us
trapped here...but why?
